convertibility_reason: Uses iCustom for AltrTrend_Signal_v2_2 indicator and depends on TradeAlgorithms.mqh external library for all trade execution, position sizing, and close logic

derived_values.name: TimeShiftSec - chart period in seconds for signal timestamp
derived_values.used_by: UpSignalTime and DnSignalTime calculation passed to BuyPositionOpen/SellPositionOpen

derived_values.name: min_rates_total - minimum bars required before EA trades

other_exits: Historical signal scan: if no direct close signal on SignalBar, EA scans backward from SignalBar+1 through all bars to find the last opposite signal for close direction - determines last trading direction for receiving position closing signals

params.MMMode: LOT - can switch between LOT, FREEMARGIN, or other MarginMode enum values from TradeAlgorithms.mqh

position_sizing.conditional_logic: MMMode input selects lot calculation method; MM=0.1 is the share of deposit when in fraction mode, or fixed lot when in LOT mode

custom_logic_notes: EA uses dual-buffer custom indicator: buffer 1=Up signal (buy arrow), buffer 0=Down signal (sell arrow). Signal is valid only if value is non-zero and not EMPTY_VALUE. Entry uses SignalBar=1 (previous completed bar). If no close signal found on current bar, EA performs a historical backward scan through all bars to find the last opposite signal to determine close direction. This scan could be expensive on long chart histories. The TradeAlgorithms.mqh library handles all trade execution internally, including BuyPositionOpen, SellPositionOpen, BuyPositionClose, SellPositionClose, and GlobalVariableDel_ functions. The Recount flag ensures signal recalculation on CopyBuffer failure. When SignalBar=0, signals are evaluated on every tick without new-bar guard.
python_conversion_notes: The AltrTrend_Signal_v2_2 custom indicator must be reimplemented in Python. It uses ADX internally (PerADX=14) with a SuperTrend-like channel calculation (K, Kstop, Kperiod params). TradeAlgorithms.mqh functions (BuyPositionOpen, SellPositionOpen, BuyPositionClose, SellPositionClose) must be reimplemented - they handle order sending with deviation, SL/TP in points, position gating via GlobalVariables, and MMMode-based lot sizing. The historical backward signal scan for determining close direction is unusual and must be preserved. SL/TP are in points (not pips) so digit adjustment depends on broker; input values of 1000/2000 points suggest 5-digit pricing (100/200 pips). Deviation_=10 points.
